status: draft: published 28 Oct 2026; becomes 1.0.0 when the Movetrics apps and Cloud read it

t.definition: FDT stamp / 10000, from the stream's own clock. Live: seconds since START (the stamp restarts at 0 on every START). Files: seconds since the first row. Never the host's receive time and never the row number.

stamp.definition: The FDT stamp in 0.1 ms ticks, unwrapped past 2^32 (the wire field is uint32 and wraps after about 4.97 days).

t_host.definition: Host clock when the frame was read (monotonic). Only for diagnostics and for mapping t onto another clock (LSL); never used as the sample time.

channels.name: fz
channels.note: vertical, positive when the plate is loaded

channels.name: cop_x
channels.note: null (NaN in arrays) where fz < cop_min_fz_n

channels.name: cop_y
channels.note: null (NaN in arrays) where fz < cop_min_fz_n

raw.name: raw
raw.definition: The six int16 integers of the 24-byte stream frame in wire order and wire signs: forceX, forceY, forceZ, momentX, momentY, momentZ. Whole newtons and newton-metres (owner, 14 Oct 2026). Kept so nothing is lost when a sign or scale decision changes.

stream_to_plate_frame.definition: plate-frame value = sign * raw value. This is Movetrics Studio's QuadrantTransform 4,3,2,1 (Studio config.ini), so a live sample and the same sample in a Studio export carry the same numbers.
stream_to_plate_frame.status: code (Studio configuration); bench check pending: one known off-centre load recorded as stream and as Studio export (docs/18 section 7 item 1)

plate.origin: centre of the plate's top surface
plate.axes: x along the 35 cm side, y along the 60 cm side, z vertical; signs as Movetrics Studio's -channels.csv
plate.status: x, y direction relative to the cable connector not yet stated by the maker (docs/18 section 7 item 4)

pair.origin: midpoint between the two plates' top-surface centres
pair.status: inferred: fitted on the 14 Oct 2026 Studio export, residual 0.37 mm

lab.origin: set by a layout file (docs/19 section 5); default = Movetrics Studio's C3D: outer corner of plate 1
lab.axes: right-handed, z up; the layout gives each plate's rotation and offset
lab.use: C3D and OpenSim exports; next to cameras and other devices

plate.name: plate
plate.definition: 1 or 2: the FDT's plate address. Wide tables prefix columns with p1_, p2_; the sum of both plates uses comb_ (Studio's word). With two FDTs merged, plates 3 and 4 are the second FDT's 1 and 2.

moment_reference.status: measured on the 14 Oct 2026 Studio export: CoP formula reproduces Studio's CoP to 0.28 mm rms; Studio's C3D ORIGIN says z = -30 mm

events.definition: Things that happen at an instant, in the same time base t. One list per recording, ordered by t.

fields.name: string (below)
fields.source: int: sync input or output (0), or the plate for saturation
fields.detail: uint16: arm timeout (min) for 5 and 10, channel mask for 7 and 9 (bits 0-5 fx..mz wrapped, bit 6 a pad channel clipped), frames for 8
fields.offset_us: int16: the edge lies this many µs after the start of tick stamp

events.status: types 1-10 from FDT 1.2.8.24 (event frame at plate address 0xFD, code 0x0E; docs/05 section 13 and vectors/sync_events.json); firmware not yet released or benched

gaps.definition: A step between two consecutive samples of one plate longer than 1.5 nominal periods. Reported, never filled or hidden. Writers that need a uniform clock (C3D, OpenSim) say what they did (refuse, split, or resample with a flag column).

fields.start_t: s: t of the last sample before the hole
fields.end_t: s: t of the first sample after it

fields.rate_hz: nominal frames per second per plate
fields.lowpass_hz: FDT digital low-pass cutoff, 0 = off, null = unknown

wide_table.definition: One row per sample instant, for CSV and spreadsheets.
wide_table.header_units: a second header line or a column suffix is never used; units are fixed by this vocabulary and repeated in the file's metadata
